dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fah, congratulations again! Tonight I'm taking you out to celebrate. Choose whichever restaurant you like.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɑː, kənˌɡrætʃəˈleɪʃənz əˈɡɛn! təˈnaɪt aɪm ˈteɪkɪŋ juː ˈaʊt tə ˈsɛləbreɪt. ˈtʃuːz wɪtʃˈɛvər ˈrɛstərɑːnt juː ˈlaɪk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wherever you want. It's up to you.
dialogue.reading: wɛrˈɛvər juː ˈwɑːnt. ɪts ˈʌp tə ˈjuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then let's go to the Japanese restaurant near Siam. I'll order whatever I like!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈrɛstərɑːnt ˈnɪr saɪˈæm. aɪl ˈɔːrdər wətˈɛvər aɪ ˈlaɪk!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! Order whatever you want. I'm paying.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈɔːrdər wətˈɛvər juː ˈwɑːnt. aɪm ˈpeɪɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks, Nam! When can we go?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm! ˈwɛn kən wiː ˈɡoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Whenever you want. I'm free all evening.
dialogue.reading: wɛnˈɛvər juː ˈwɑːnt. aɪm ˈfriː ˈɔːl ˈiːvnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Give me ten minutes. Which dress should I wear, the blue one or the white one?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡɪv miː ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts. ˈwɪtʃ ˈdrɛs ʃʊd aɪ ˈwɛr, ðə ˈbluː ˈwʌn ɔːr ðə ˈwaɪt ˈwʌn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Whichever one you feel comfortable in.
dialogue.reading: wɪtʃˈɛvər ˈwʌn juː ˈfiːl ˈkʌmftərbəl ˈɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! And when you're in Chiang Mai, call me whenever you feel homesick.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ənd wɛn jʊr ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ, ˈkɔːl miː wɛnˈɛvər juː ˈfiːl ˈhoʊmsɪk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I will. And you can visit me whenever you like!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɪl. ənd juː kən ˈvɪzɪt miː wɛnˈɛvər juː ˈlaɪk!
